text:
alex.cs: Quick capture from Acme onboarding call — pasting short notes for product triage.

oliver.pm: thanks — can you list the asks succinctly? we should decide priority now

alex.cs: sure — three main asks:
- "project-summaries" view in Console: list by customer with active sessions + token usage
- per-route quota alerting: threshold-based email + slack
- embeddings export: scheduled export of vectors for 3rd-party analytics

maya.cs: noted. Acme mentioned renewal concern if dashboards stay manual 😬

ravi.eng: technical flags — project-summaries looks like a new index + aggregation. embeddings export is heavier (storage + bandwidth). per-route alerting mostly frontend + alerting rule.

alex.cs: rough priority proposal from CS: 1) per-route alerting (quick win), 2) project-summaries (high impact), 3) embeddings export (needs scoping)

oliver.pm: agree. can we map effort? @ravi.eng, guesstimate t-shirt sizes?

ravi.eng: per-route alerting = S. project-summaries = M-L (need infra work + rollup job). embeddings export = L (storage + retention + consent checks)

maya.cs: I'll bundle this into the customer-health note. Acme is at 65% NPS and asked for visible usage metrics — tie that to project-summaries

alex.cs: adding a quick snippet to capture UX desires from the call:
```
- default landing: projects table (columns: name, last-active, avg-latency, token-cost-week)
- click -> quick timeline (7d) + export CSV
```

oliver.pm: i'll create a GH issue and tag eng + design. add labels: cs-capture, renewal-risk, quick-win

alex.cs: thanks — pinging @onboard-bot to attach the call recording and raw notes

onboard-bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.example/rec/abcd1234

maya.cs: will follow up w/ Acme PM: share timeline for per-route alerting and sample screenshots once design mocks ready :thumbsup:

alex.cs: one more note — customer asked for cost visibility per route to help internal billing. add to project-summaries scope? or separate task?

oliver.pm: let's add as a column in project-summaries initially; if Acme asks for billing-grade export we'll spin a separate epic

alex.cs: all right — moving to triage. thanks team :raised_hands:
